name: My Celebrity Boyfriend Killed Me
overview: Aspiring actress Claire Evans secretly falls in love with powerful producer Mitch Sterling, but their relationship turns tragic when he tries to silence her after she becomes pregnant. Twenty years later, Claire’s orphaned daughter, Clara, has risen to fame as one of the industry’s brightest stars, while acclaimed screenwriter Alex still carries the scars of the past. Together, they set out to expose Mitch’s crimes and seek justice for the lives he destroyed.
